supportWidget.title: Support
supportWidget.subtitle: Quick answers — tap a question
supportWidget.intro: Hi! 👋 Tap a question below for an instant answer, or reach us directly for anything else.
supportWidget.noResults: No matching questions. Try contacting us directly below.

faqs.a: Delivery is instant in most cases — within seconds to a few minutes after your payment is confirmed. You'll get the code or top-up right in your account and by email.
You can pay by bank transfer (اوو-كاش, MyCashi, or BOK) — just upload a screenshot of your transfer — or from your wallet balance if you've topped it up.

faqs.q: How do I add funds to my wallet?
faqs.a: Go to Dashboard → Wallet → Add funds, choose a bank, transfer the amount, then upload your payment screenshot. Our team confirms it and credits your wallet.

faqs.q: My order is still pending, what do I do?
faqs.a: Pending means we're waiting on your payment screenshot or reviewing it. Check Dashboard → Orders — if it's been over a few hours, open a support ticket and we'll check it right away.
First check Dashboard → Orders for your delivered code. If it's marked Paid but nothing arrived, please open a support ticket with your order number and we'll resolve it fast.
Since these are digital products, orders can't be cancelled once fulfilled. If something went wrong on our end, open a support ticket and we'll sort it out — see our Return Policy for details.
Yes. We don't store card numbers — payments are manual bank transfers reviewed by our team, and all data is handled securely.

faqs.q: I entered the wrong Player ID / details
faqs.a: Contact support immediately via WhatsApp or a ticket before the order is fulfilled — once delivered we usually can't reverse it.

faqs.q: I didn't get my verification code
faqs.a: Check your spam/junk folder and mark it as “Not spam”. Still nothing? Use “Resend code” on the verification page.

faqs.q: How do I change the language or currency?
faqs.a: Use the language switcher in the header to change between Arabic and English. The store currently runs in Sudanese Pound (ج.س).

faqs.q: How do I track my order?
faqs.a: Go to Dashboard → Orders. Tap any order to see its full status, payment proof, and chat directly with our team about it.

faqs.q: How can I contact a real person?
faqs.a: Use the WhatsApp button below, or open a support ticket from your dashboard — a real team member will reply.
